notes.title: Update 0.6
notes.content:
[h2]Added[/h2]
✅A new arena named "Extraction Facility" that contains a number of new features
✅Added interiors that can be entered by players 
✅Added an automatic laser rifle that is so powerful that it punches through your targets
✅Added a delay to player respawn so that killing players becomes more rewarding that can be set by the host
✅Added on screen tutorials showing the key bindings relevant to the current input device

[h2]Changed[/h2]
✏️Players now automatically respawn when a new game starts
✏️Some weapons can now fire through targets damaging everything it passes through
✏️Turned up the blood effects

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
🪲Made sure that slow connections time out properly and returns players to the main menu
🪲Player input is properly enabled and disabled when opening and closing menus

notes.title: Update 0.5
notes.content:
[h1]Update 0.5[/h1]
Exciting update packed with additions, improvements, and fixes! Reticles now grace all weapons, ensuring your aim is dead-on. Weapons now have their own styled weapon cases to show where on the map the it belongs and will respawn when it is dropped. All of the User interface have gotten a facelift and some overdue additions, such as settings and win score selection. 

Most notable in this update is that in includes support for Linux🐧 and therein native SteamDeck support. 


[h2]Added[/h2]
✅ Added reticles to all the weapons 
✅ Added a black fade that appears when loading
✅ Added corpses for the non player creatures that persist through the whole play session
✅ Added weapon cases to all of the weapons where the weapons appear and respawn when dropped
✅ Added ability to set the score win condition in the host menu
✅ Added display settings to the options menu
✅ Added audio settings to the options menu
✅ Added language support for the menus in German, Spanish, Chinese, Japanese, and Korean

[h2]Changed[/h2]
✏️ Changed the leaderboard to show the top 3 players with name and color and relevant portrait
✏️ Changed the AI states of the non player creatures to avoid running into obstacles to prevent them from just gathering in the corners of the arenas 
✏️ Changed the respawn point logic to make sure that players don't respawn unarmed right in front of other players
✏️ Made visual improvements to the [b]Glowing Meadow[/b] to give it more texture to the ground and more distinct colors
✏️ Made visual improvements to the [b]Alikabok Canyon[/b] to break up more repetitive elements in the environment 
✏️ Made improvements to the physical borders of the arenas and obstacles in the arenas to improve the feel and make players less prone to get wedged between obstacles and having to turn around
✏️ Made the map selection in the hosting menu a multi selection where the host selects the maps that they wis to include in the map rotation for the session
✏️ Overhauled the UI styles

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
🪲Fixed Issue where lobbies would not close gracefully when host disconnected and started a new game
🪲Fixed Issue where objects such as weapons would stay in players inventory between game sessions
🪲Fixed Issue where other players footsteps just played indefinitely
🪲Fixed a whole bunch of issues where UI would not display properly between different game sessions
🪲Fixed audio issues where certain sounds would have an unnatural reach across the map

notes.title: Update 0.4
notes.content:
[h1]Preview Build 0.4.5-b1[/h1]

This update is juicier than a fight week Brock Lesnar! 
I have added a long awaited feature that really adds to the gameplay. There are now NPC characters running around that are just waiting to be fired upon. 
Please Enjoy!

[h2]Added[/h2]
✅ Added NPCS!!!! A clumsy and skittish little bipedal creature that is good for target practice, generating score, and making sure that campers don't spend too much time hiding
✅ Added score gained text that appears when you hit a target that earns you score
✅ Added a (simple) leaderboard UI that shows all the players and who has the score lead
✅ Added a progress bar under your your score number to show how much more you need to win the competition
✅ Added a feedback pls button in the main menu

[h2]Changed[/h2]
✏️ Instead of having to press "Play Again" as host, there is now a timer that counts down until next match starts
✏️ When next match starts it changes to a different map automatically
✏️  Changed some of the art in the main menu UI, New game logo, new key art, new button design
✏️ Changed the enter game and color selection menu to be centered and a little nicer design
✏️ Earned score is now based on how much actual damage was dealt to a character (when they die) and not the total potential damage if they had enough remaining health Eg: No more 1000 score for killing a player with 1 HP
✏️ Changed the graphics on the splash screen

[h2]Fixed[/h2]
🪲Fixed Issue where respawn would appear when toggling the In game menu even though the player isn't dead
🪲Fixed issues with score not being properly reset when a new game starts
🪲Fixed focus issue so that the respawn button is focused when it appears to make it easier for gamepad players

[h2]Related Planned[/h2]
➡️Add a crouch walk cycle
➡️Make a nice looking leaderboard
➡️Add persistent dead bodies of the NPCs
➡️Make different game modes (Eg. hunt down NPCs within a time limit, Teamplay of different kinds)

Come join the [url=https://discord.gg/xYs8WA6s4x]Discord[/url] and let me know what you think would be a fun addition! 
NOW LET THERE BE CARNAGE!👹
